statement: NIOSH reports that machine maintenance and servicing can expose workers to severe injury or death from hazardous energy when effective lockout/tagout controls are not followed, and recommends a hazardous-energy control program that includes lockout/tagout procedures and worker training.

review.rationale: Drafted from NIOSH Publication 2011-156 and cross-checked against the current CDC/NIOSH publication page on September 15, 2026. It provides an independent occupational-safety evidence source for the servicing/hazardous-energy boundary without asserting that the NIOSH recommendation itself determines legal applicability in every cultivation workplace.
review.notes: Human occupational-safety review is required before promotion. Keep legal applicability and employer-specific authorization separate from this NIOSH recommendation.

sourceContext.contextTitle: Routine Operator Care versus Skilled Maintenance
